main_text.p: quere non poterant, Achæos fua facta tuentes, libertatem, patriam, & fœderis, quod cum Romanis iciffent, æqualitatem memorare, per quam nec fibi in ea, quæ extra Peloponnefum Romani, nec Romanis in ea, quæ in Pelopon-nefo Achæi agerent, inquirere fas effet, effentque non ipfi minus quàm Romani in rebus fuis [illegible, ~10 letters] : quanquàm affirmarent iidem Achæi, nihil omnino à fe in caufa Lacedæmoniorum factum, quod non optimo jure & potuerint facere, & debuerint, & quod non expediret tum Achaiæ ftatui, tum ipfis Lacedæmoniis, tum etiam fociis Romanis, fi fecus factum fuiffet. In Ro-manis, qui ignem hunc foderent, habebantur Q. Cæcilius Metellus, Appius Claudius Pulcher, Q. Marcius Philip-pus, qui alii poft alios cum collegis ad infpiciendas res Macedoniæ ac Græciæ à fenatu Romano fuère miffi: qui præ-ter alias caufas, quibus ipfi finguli per fe movebantur, etiam tacito defiderio fenatus & primorum civitatis fuæ in-ferviebant. Iftorum verò hoc confilium erat, poftquàm jam metus & periculum à Philippo & Ætolis, & maximè ab Antiocho potentiffimo Syriæ rege nu-per in ordinem redacto deceffiffent, contra quos fida & felici opera Achæo-

page.notes: Greek word after "in rebus fuis" (about line 6 from the end of the first half) is not legible on the scan; marked as illegible. Faint dark marks at the lower left and the lower right edge (the "&" and small symbols beside the last line) look like show-through or a stain and were not transcribed; a gathering signature may be faintly present at the lower right but could not be read, so none is given. The first line begins mid-sentence, so the paragraph is marked as continued. The last word "Achæo-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page.
